title: Projektleiter Lüftung (m/w/d) | Köln
description:
Als eine führende Ingenieurgesellschaft für technische Gebäudeausrüstung (TGA) planen und realisieren wir seit über 30 Jahren technische Anlagen für Gebäude aller Art – unter anderem von Universitäten und Lehranstalten, Bürokomplexen, Laboren über Krankenhäuser bis hin zu Forschungseinrichtungen.
 Die Baubranche und die Technik entwickeln sich stetig weiter. Deshalb sind wir immer auf der Suche nach neuen Fachkräften, die unser Unternehmen mit Leidenschaft, Neugier und Engagement mitprägen und unsere Marktposition stärken.
 An unserem Hauptstandort Köln suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Verstärkung im Bereich Projektleitung für ELT/ Elektrotechnik (m/w/d).
 Aufgaben
 Eigenverantwortliche Leitung und Steuerung von anspruchsvollen Projekten im Bereich Elektrotechnik innerhalb der Technischen Gebäudeausrüstung (TGA)
 Fachliche und organisatorische Verantwortung für die Projektabwicklung über alle Leistungsphasen der HOAI
 Entwicklung innovativer und wirtschaftlicher Konzepte im Bereich Lüftung für Neu- und Bestandsbauten
 Koordination von Projektteams sowie Zusammenarbeit mit Fachplanern, Bauherren, Architekten und externen Partnern
 Überwachung von Terminen, Kosten und Qualitäten während der gesamten Projektlaufzeit
 Durchführung technischer Abstimmungen und Planungsbesprechungen
 Sicherstellung der Einhaltung relevanter Normen, Vorschriften und Richtlinien
 Unterstützung bei der Ausschreibung, Vergabe und Abrechnung von elektrotechnischen Anlagen
 Ansprechpartner für Kunden und Projektbeteiligte in allen projektbezogenen Fragestellungen
 Qualifikation
 Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Versorgungstechnik, Energie- und Gebäudetechnik, Gebäudetechnik mit Schwerpunkt Lüftungs- und Klimatechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
 Alternativ Weiterbildung zum staatlich geprüften Techniker oder Meister (m/w/d) im Bereich Lüftungs-, Klima- oder Versorgungstechnik

title: Staff Design Verification Engineer, AI HW
description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

Our Tensix team is building custom AI compute cores, RISC-V CPUs, and chiplet-based architectures for datacenter, edge, and automotive AI. Design Verification Engineers on this team validate compute IP and subsystems and build scalable DV infrastructure to keep verification fast, automated, and production-grade.

This role is hybrid, based out of Toronto, ON, Austin, TX or Belgrade, Serbia.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

 

Who You Are

  • Experienced in modern verification methodologies with strong SystemVerilog skills and exposure to structured testbench development.
  • Comfortable working from block-level to system-level verification and reasoning about microarchitecture behavior from specs and waveforms.
  • Proficient in Linux environments with Python, or Bash scripting for automate builds, parse logs, manage CI pipelines.

title: Principal Data Strategist (m/f/d)
description:
Principal data strategists at Thoughtworks are experienced consultants who work with clients to create winning data solutions that meet business goals. They play a pivotal role in developing modern data architecture approaches that directly address our clients' key business objectives. Their responsibilities span in-depth reviews of current data and technology strategy, targeted data strategy, guiding clients to unlock the full potential of data, and providing high-level roadmaps.

This role entails a mix of advisory responsibilities in data strategy and governance, coupled with a solid delivery-lead role and a breadth of data and AI ecosystem expertise.

This is a client-facing, builder's leadership role. You will start with a small, senior team and grow it through technical depth, delivery excellence and thought leadership, rather than inheriting a large organisation to manage. The role is based in Germany and requires regular travel to client sites, up to approximately 50% of your time.

Job responsibilities

  • You will collaborate closely with clients to understand their business ecosystem and goals, and co-create data and technology strategies aligned with their objectives.
  • You will help define a clear vision for the client enterprise to become data-driven and aligned with the overall business strategy.
  • You will consult on complex data programs, providing technical leadership and guidance as a data subject-matter expert.
  • You will lead and interact with clients across various domains, addressing challenging problems, and collaborate with sales to turn them into viable solutions and winning proposals.
  • You will act as a translator between business, data and IT, and communicate data strategy to senior client stakeholders, including C-level.

title: Senior Consultant (Strategy & Data/AI Transformation)
description:
Who is Artefact?

Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI. We combine the rigour of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.

With 2,500+ consultants, data scientists and engineers, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi. Our Swiss offices are at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.

Main Responsibilities

As a Senior Consultant in our Zurich/Lausanne office, you will work at the intersection of strategy consulting and data and AI delivery. You will:

  • Strategy Development: Work with client leadership teams to address high-stakes questions. How can AI reshape our business model? How should we govern and organise for data? Which strategic programmes deliver the most impact?
  • Structured Problem-Solving: Break complex challenges down into decisions a client can act on, combining consulting rigour with a working knowledge of what current AI can and cannot actually do.
  • Solution Design: Turn a business question into a solution shape — what data it depends on, what kind of platform or product it should sit on, and what “good” looks like once it is built. You will do this alongside our data scientists and engineers.
  • Project Delivery: Support engagements end to end, from hypothesis framing and market and competitor analysis through to data maturity assessments, client workshops, governance design and implementation roadmaps.

title: Senior AI Engineer / Technical Consultant
description:
Who is Artefact?

Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital, and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.

With 1,800+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 23 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. Our Romandie office (Geneva/Lausanne) is at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.

Main Responsibilities

As a Senior Technical Consultant / Senior AI Engineer, you will lead the design and delivery of impactful AI and data solutions. You’ll combine hands-on engineering with client advisory, guiding multi-disciplinary teams from opportunity framing to production deployment.

  • Own solution architecture & delivery: Define end-to-end architectures (data, ML/LLM, APIs, security), make build/buy decisions, and drive projects from PoC to production with reliability, observability, and cost in mind.

  • Lead complex PoCs & pilots: Scope, prototype, and validate AI/ML use cases (incl. LLMs/GenAI, RAG, fine-tuning, evaluation) and convert successful pilots into scalable products.
